title: 03_severe_9panel_engine_vs_sbml
interpretation: Severe arm, all 9 observables, engine vs SBML extraction over 72 h. Inflammation (tissue integrity, blood pathogen) overlaps bit-for-bit; every divergence is in the hemodynamic layer. Dotted lines mark the SBP<100 / MAP<65 / HR>90 thresholds — both arms cross MAP<65 within 72 h, the extraction (steel blue) first.
